input_tokens.meaning: Input tokens consumed by this request's distinct real provider attempts.
source_priority: TOKENIZER_ACTUAL only when model ID and revision exactly match

output_tokens.meaning: Output tokens consumed by this request's distinct real provider attempts.
source_priority: TOKENIZER_ACTUAL only when model ID and revision exactly match

inference_latency_ms.meaning: Integer milliseconds measured with a monotonic clock around each real provider attempt.
inference_latency_ms.aggregation: Sum only completed, durably audited real attempts; a cache-only event contributes 0.

rule_substitution_count.frozen_definition: Exactly 1 for one pure-rule evaluate request, representing the service rule chain replacing model inference; it is not the count of individual rules inspected or branches matched.

provider_usage.total_tokens_only: MISSING; it is never split or used to invent positive values.
provider_usage.partial_pair: Rejected as an ambiguous measurement configuration.

retry_and_deduplication.deduplication_key: unique event_id / attempt_id within a GovernanceSession
retry_and_deduplication.new_real_retry: Its newly reported exact usage and latency are counted once.
retry_and_deduplication.historical_token_policy: No prior-attempt or cached token usage is copied into a later event.

cache.HIT: Records 0 model tokens and 0 inference latency; historical metrics remain only in prior event totals.
cache.FALLBACK: Records an explicit safe reason code such as provider_unavailable and does not claim a live model result.
cache.BYPASSED: Used for pure-rule evaluate and premeasured compatibility records.

governance_record.audit_failure_policy: A sink failure raises GovernanceLogWriteError and does not update request totals.
